"""Compact all fixed candidate/control/parent changes without inference."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2')
scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');groups=[]
for end in ['raw','EMA']:
 method=f'routed-common-{end}-step1000';control=f'common-control-{end}-step1000'
 for a in scores['summary']:
  if a['method']!=method or a['kind']=='real':continue
  key=a['kind'],a['condition'],a['cohort']
  for baseline in ['parent',control]:
   b=next(b for b in scores['summary'] if (b['kind'],b['condition'],b['cohort'])==key and b['method']==baseline)
   fields={k:{'candidate':v,'baseline':b[k],'percent_change':100*(v/b[k]-1) if b[k] else None}
    for k,v in a.items() if isinstance(v,(int,float)) and k not in ['cases','condition'] and k in b}
   groups.append({'method':method,'baseline':baseline,'kind':key[0],'condition':key[1],'cohort':key[2],'fields':fields})
output=root/'matched-effects-summary-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-array-only-all-fixed-cohort-matched-summary','scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    'comparisons':groups,'training_unit_and_mask_audit':ref(root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json'),
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'All four fixed V166 endpoints;identical124909-parameter/47-tensor V165 heads/data/init/loss values/weights/optimizer/inference. Both common weight1/unit16DN16,difference floor2/weight1/epsilon.003,flat anchor.25. Only common-loss derivative holds support fixed in candidate;other losses train support normally. Surrogate adjoint,not finite-difference derivative. Exact V165 control. Historical contrasts mix interventions;adaptive related cohort,not independent scenes/significance. All cases/worst increases retained. Actual native viewing only after original-detail inspection;both protected scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs,ISO100 qualitative refs,notGT. Eight retained native columns. Failed v1 complex telemetry preserved;v2 fixes magnitude RMS.56 parity roots/20leaf checks adopted,3 discarded prefix roots/12images counted separately;no full-training restart.'})
for g in groups:
 if g['baseline']=='parent':continue
 fields=['full_error_RMS_DN16','template_gain','blank_error_RMS_DN16'] if g['kind']=='mesh' else ['quiet_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16','crop_DC_RMS_DN16'] if g['kind']=='mixed-quiet' else ['full_error_RMS_DN16','block32_RMS_DN16','crop_relative_band_error','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain']
 print(g['method'],g['kind'],g['condition'],g['cohort'],{k:g['fields'][k] for k in fields if k in g['fields']})
